subject.title: [Security] Missing CSRF protection on local control plane HTTP routes

question: Does the reporter have a current-main proof showing a browser-origin request reaching a specific authenticated configuration-mutation endpoint without the existing Gateway origin and admin-scope checks?
rationale: Source inspection contradicts the reported entry point, but a security owner must evaluate any private endpoint details or proof before determining whether this is a false path report or a separate undiscovered boundary gap.

options.title: Request private endpoint proof
options.body: Keep the issue open while requesting the exact route, request transcript, deployment configuration, and observed unauthorized mutation through the repository's private security channel.

options.title: Treat as hardening only
options.body: If no boundary-crossing reproduction exists, reclassify the report as non-actionable defense-in-depth rather than changing the ACP bridge.
